problem: A large autonomous proving run can waste work, replay accepted boards, or count unauthenticated output when pilot, watchdog, and resume state are implicit.
rootCause: Generation and acceptance were not governed by one fail-closed durable state machine.
fixSummary: Require an authentic accepted pilot before generation, atomically checkpoint every accepted board, resume the exact manifest index, bound every stage with a watchdog, and stop rejected output for an engine improvement before retry.
